entities.name: Abolqasem Salavati
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abolqasem Salavati is an Iranian judge and former head of the 15th branch of the Islamic Revolutionary Court in Tehran, Iran. In recent years, he had been the judge of numerous controversial cases. He has been sanctioned by the United States and the European Union.
